description:
High-performance Java library for classic or symbolic
		communication with S7 PLCs. Provides symbolic or absolute read/write
		over TCP/IP and MPI/PPI; includes multi area optimisation and sample
		code. Cyber Resilience Act (EU 2024/2847) documents: EU DoC URL:
		https://www.indi-an.com/legal/cra/plccomfors7-java/160103/eu-declaration-of-conformity.pdf
		; Guide URL (Annex II):
		https://www.indi-an.com/legal/cra/plccomfors7-java/160103/security-integration-guide.pdf
		; Vulnerability contact: support@indi-an.com
